evals.prompt: Please audit https://news.ycombinator.com for responsive design. Check how it looks across all major device sizes and give me a full report.
evals.expected_output: A responsiveness audit report covering multiple breakpoints. Should identify Hacker News as having horizontal overflow or layout issues on mobile. Includes screenshots and structured findings with severity levels.
expectations: Checks that agent-browser is installed before proceeding with the audit
Takes screenshots at 3 or more different breakpoints
Detects horizontal overflow or layout issues on mobile (320px or 375px)
Reports at least one Critical or High severity issue
Produces a structured report with named sections (e.g. Summary, Issues, Recommendations)
Saves screenshots to a file path (not just describes them)

evals.prompt: Can you do a responsiveness audit on https://tailwindcss.com? I want to know if there are any mobile layout issues across all device sizes.
evals.expected_output: A full 8-breakpoint audit report. Tailwind's own site is well-built so overall status should pass. Includes screenshots at multiple breakpoints, structured check matrix results.
expectations: Takes screenshots at 5 or more different breakpoints (standard 8-breakpoint mode)
Produces a structured report with named sections
Does not report Critical issues on tailwindcss.com (well-built responsive site)
Runs the layout check matrix (mentions checking overflow, navigation, touch targets, etc.)
Saves screenshots to a file path

evals.prompt: Do a quick mobile responsiveness check on https://example.com - just check 320px, 375px, and 768px and tell me what you find.
evals.expected_output: A quick mobile audit (3 breakpoints only). Takes screenshots at 320px, 375px, 768px. example.com is a simple static page that should mostly pass.
expectations: Tests exactly the 3 requested breakpoints: 320px, 375px, and 768px
Does NOT run all 8 standard breakpoints (respects the quick mobile mode)
Takes at least 3 screenshots (one per breakpoint)
Produces a structured report with per-breakpoint findings
Reports minimal issues on example.com (simple static page, mostly passes)
